remarks: Welcome to Lansdowne, one of Westport's premier condominium complexes. This beautifully updated home offers the ease of condo living with the feel of a single family residence. The entry features wallpaper that peeks your interest. Inside, the ship lap walls in the family room have a fresh look. The kitchen has seating at the island and ample dining space. It also has a cozy fireplace. There is plenty of storage along with  Thermador appliances and a Bosch microwave-convection oven.There is additional entertaining space in the dining room and a cozy office/sunroom. Off the sunroom there are sliders to a lovely private patio. Upstairs hosts two bedrooms, two completely renovated bathrooms and two walk in closets. The primary bath has a wet room, a soaking tub and heated floors. Move in and let the fun begin.
